اعتنقتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقْتُمْ (iʕtanaqtum) /iʕ.ta.naq.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقْتُمْ (uʕtuniqtum) /uʕ.tu.niq.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
